entries.title: Rogue Legacy
entries.definitive_edition: Rogue Legacy on Windows PC, plus iOS Wanderer Edition secondary cleanup

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC / native iOS secondary
emulation.notes: Use native PC for the main route and iOS only for Wanderer Edition-exclusive content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with optional mod content; iOS secondary for exclusives.

primary.version: Current PC release with Anniversary Update / optional Lament of Zors mod
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best main-play version because it has the complete base game, PC capture/settings flexibility, Anniversary Update support, and the documented Lament of Zors mod route for extra high-end content. The iOS Wanderer Edition has exclusive traits, rooms, and mini-bosses, so it is a secondary cleanup route rather than the fidelity-first main run.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Rogue Legacy on Steam for Windows PC and play the current build. After the main route, use the iOS Wanderer Edition only if Sami wants its exclusive mobile-specific content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Wanderer Edition exclusive traits, rooms, mini-bosses, and remastered mobile control scheme.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Wanderer Edition-specific rooms/traits/mini-bosses on iOS after the PC main run.
secondary.why: Wanderer Edition includes the base game plus Anniversary Update and new iOS-specific traits, rooms, and mini-bosses.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Anniversary Update and Steam-documented Lament of Zors mod route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best main route with PC capture/settings flexibility; iOS Wanderer content is secondary cleanup.
skip: useful native routes, but Windows PC remains the main capture/settings target.
skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC plus iOS Wanderer cleanup.
skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC plus iOS Wanderer cleanup.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC plus iOS Wanderer cleanup.

all_releases.fidelity: Wanderer Edition mobile route with remastered controls and iOS-specific content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: play only the Wanderer Edition-exclusive traits, rooms, and mini-bosses after the PC main route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the best main/fidelity route, but iOS Wanderer Edition has documented exclusive mobile-specific content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wanderer Edition is not the main fidelity route, but it has exclusive mobile-specific content. Lament of Zors is a mod route, not a required vanilla story path.

entries.title: Rogue Legacy 2
entries.definitive_edition: Rogue Legacy 2 on Windows PC with Swan Song update

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with final major update content.

primary.version: Current PC release with Swan Song update
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archival version because it covers the full release plus the final major Swan Song update while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. Console versions also received the major free update content, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Rogue Legacy 2 on Steam for Windows PC and update to the current build including the Swan Song update.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Swan Song final major update.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: useful native routes, but Windows PC remains the main capture/settings target.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release across Xbox One and Series X|S.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation release with latest free content updates, Fabled Heroes and Swan Song, plus PS5 DualSense features.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC route includes the final major Swan Song update and has no documented content disadvantage.
